authorityFamily: Louisiana Code of Criminal Procedure Articles 987 through 995 and 998 statutory forms
blockers: Articles 987, 988, 989, 991, 992, and 994 are retained as statutory HTML authority records whose measurements are not uniquely selectable as official-PDF source identities; authority must designate their implementation lane without inventing a PDF source.

The exact Article 993, 995, and 998 identities are source-gated flat PDFs and require captain projection, byte verification, page-geometry inspection, and visual confirmation before coordinate overlays can be activated.
Article 993 is a continuation form for additional charges or counts and requires an adopted conditional-repeat policy before packet assembly can include it.
Article 987 set-aside sequencing, Article 988 fee-exemption eligibility, and parish-specific filing mechanics remain route and authority-review dependencies.
The first-offense-marijuana fee treatment and all post-revision statutory effects require freshness review; the scaffold does not change legal design or infer a current fee rule.
The Article 990 agency response is not a participant-generated component in the retained tracks and must not be silently added to participant packets.
invariants: Do not alter statutory fixed language, Louisiana legal design, track selection, or component ordering.
Use the official term Motion for Expungement and do not relabel statutory motions as petitions.
Participant signatures, dates signed, certifications, hearing fields, clerk fields, agency-response fields, judge fields, and judicial findings remain blank.
Article 991 and Article 992 judicial decision fields, and Article 995 order fields, are never populated as participant-owned values.
Article 988 is conditional and is never included or completed unless the adopted route and fee-exemption conditions are satisfied.
Protected identifiers, including Social Security number data, remain manual or redacted until a confirmed ownership and data-protection policy expressly permits population.
Every shared physical form is rendered once per participant packet; repeatable Article 993 pages require an explicit deterministic repeat rule.
Repository-private paths are identity evidence only and are never opened by packet code or the dedicated verifier.
No HTML-to-PDF improvisation, source download, URL fallback, fuzzy identity match, live-route change, or runtime enablement is permitted.
